latin: Tollite iugum meum super vos, et discite a me, quia mitis sum, et humilis corde: et invenietis requiem animabus vestris.
english: Take up my yoke upon you, and learn of me, because I am meek, and humble of heart: and you shall find rest to your souls.

english_source.translator: Challoner revision of the Douay-Rheims Bible

latin: Si quis vult post me venire, abneget semetipsum, et tollat crucem suam, et sequatur me.
english: If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

english_source.translator: Challoner revision of the Douay-Rheims Bible

latin: Timor Domini disciplina sapientiae: et gloriam praecedit humilitas.
english: The fear of the Lord is the lesson of wisdom: and humility goeth before glory.

english_source.translator: Challoner revision of the Douay-Rheims Bible

latin: Sacrificium Deo spiritus contribulatus: cor contritum, et humiliatum, Deus, non despicies.
english: A sacrifice to God is an afflicted spirit: a contrite and humbled heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.

english_source.translator: Challoner revision of the Douay-Rheims Bible

latin: Si quis vult post me venire, abneget semetipsum, et tollat crucem suam quotidie, et sequatur me.
english: If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me.

english_source.translator: Challoner revision of the Douay-Rheims Bible

latin: Quanto magnus es, humilia te in omnibus, et coram Deo invenies gratiam.
english: The greater thou art, the more humble thyself in all things, and thou shalt find grace before God.

english_source.translator: Challoner revision of the Douay-Rheims Bible

latin: Humiliavit semetipsum, factus obediens usque ad mortem, mortem autem crucis.
english: He humbled himself, becoming obedient unto death, even to the death of the cross.

english_source.translator: Challoner revision of the Douay-Rheims Bible

latin: Omnes autem invicem humilitatem insinuate, quia Deus superbis resistit, humilibus autem dat gratiam.
english: All of you insinuate humility one to another, for God resisteth the proud, but to the humble he giveth grace.

english_source.translator: Challoner revision of the Douay-Rheims Bible

latin: Humiliamini in conspectu Domini, et exaltabit vos.
english: Be humbled in the sight of the Lord, and he will exalt you.

english_source.translator: Challoner revision of the Douay-Rheims Bible

latin: Nolite conformari huic saeculo, sed reformamini in novitate sensus vestri, ut probetis quae sit voluntas Dei, bona, et beneplacens, et perfecta.
english: And be not conformed to this world; but be reformed in the newness of your mind, that you may prove what is the good, and the acceptable, and the perfect will of God.

english_source.translator: Challoner revision of the Douay-Rheims Bible

latin: Obsculta, o fili, praecepta magistri, et inclina aurem cordis tui, et admonitionem pii patris libenter excipe et efficaciter comple.
english: Hearken, O my son, to the precepts of thy master, and incline the ear of thine heart; willingly receive and faithfully fulfil the admonition of thy loving father.

english_source.edition: The Rule of St Benedict (London: Chatto & Windus, 1909)

work: Rule of St Benedict, ch. 5 (On Obedience)
latin: Primus humilitatis gradus est oboedientia sine mora. Haec convenit his qui nihil sibi a Christo carius aliquid existimant.
english: The first degree of humility is obedience without delay. This becometh those who hold nothing dearer to them than Christ.

english_source.edition: The Rule of St Benedict (London: Chatto & Windus, 1909)

work: Rule of St Benedict, ch. 7 (On Humility)
latin: Si volumus summae humilitatis culmen attingere et ad exaltationem illam caelestem ad quam per praesentis vitae humilitatem ascenditur volumus velociter pervenire, actibus nostris ascendentibus scala illa erigenda est.
english: If we wish to reach the summit of the highest humility, and speedily to attain that heavenly exaltation to which we ascend by the humility of the present life, we must by our ascending actions set up that ladder.

english_source.edition: The Rule of St Benedict (London: Chatto & Windus, 1909)
